open_points.subject: A20 rule 3 Linux-only host constraint
open_points.text: A release runs on Linux and on no other host, no version named (owner, 2026-10-18).
open_points.question: What release/build component owns and enforces the Linux-only host constraint, given that State 3 assigns A20 rule 3 to no runtime module and names only dependency and sandbox-runtime verification as release-artifact responsibilities?
options: The release packaging/build metadata prevents installation or launch on non-Linux hosts
A named external release gate verifies the target host before producing the release
A runtime module checks the host despite A20 rule 3 otherwise being outside the running kernel
open_points.default_guess: Treat the release packaging/build process as the owner and make it produce Linux-only artifacts.
